I was beyond excited for this show and as a huge fan of the movie and an ex dancer I expected so much (also the price is very promising...). After waiting for a LONG time in the line (30-40min) you enter the most amazing place, the teater is very beautiful with everything red and you feel like something amazing is coming. Then the show started....... First I will say that the costumes and the scene is amazing (like everyone wrote in the negative comments), but the dancers.... Each one of the female dancers is a good dancer on their own, but together.. There was NO SYNCHRONY whatsoever, they were all over the place, the first dancer didn't even know the choreography! I was shocked! Than some guest rollerskating couple appeared and that was amazing, but then as soon as the dancers got back it was a disaster again!
Overall I don't regret the fact that I spent 100€, but I am very disappointed that the show is not at the level it should be - for the price and for the popularity of it.
In my opinion, they are hiring cheaper dancers and choreographer, or there is just lack of practice because if you can't do the CAN-CAN in the right way, is that even moulin roughe than? Very sad that this is what they decited to offer.
An amazing show with comedy Romance and nudity (toppless) this is a must visit rekomendation from me

My wife's fantasy was always to be a June Taylor dancer. While my wife enjoyed to show, I was absolutely bored after 10 mints, as were 20 % of the audience. 10% were cheering and whistling (for what??), and the balance of the audience sat there midley entertained. If you need loud music, continuous non-stop stimuli, aroller skates act, swimming with snakes, tumbling acts, you must love Las Vegas lounge shows or the Carnival/Circus. This type of entertainment went out in the 1940's. Not my cup of tea. We haver been to Paris 5 times and have done all the major sites and activities, now focusing on on level 2 or 5?
The show itself was good but it was very hot inside and it didn't help that you are literally packed in like sardines! I would recommend just beware, it can be very hot and zero room to move.

We attended the 11 pm, show only, we received a bottle of champagne between the 2 of us.The show itself was very good. However we were jammed in like sardines & I had to look over my shoulder to watch the show, which I found very uncomfortable. Getting in & out to the toilet would have also been a mission if required ! With better positioned seats it would have been a more enjoyable evening.

The evening was wonderful. The performers were fantastic. We did not eat there but the drinks were fine. I did not expect to enjoy myself that much but was pleasantly surprised at how exciting it was. Even though it was expensive, I felt that I got my money’s worth. The performance was well paced . I was amazed at how many different acts there were. I would highly recommend it , especially if you have never been there before. There were many people there but there were well organized and very able to handle large crowds

Prior to visiting Paris, I’d never really thought much of wanting to go to the moulin rouge. I haven’t seen the movie, it’s not something I was real keen on. However I was on a tour that included attendance and I decided ‘why not?’
(I still paid 100 euro). At first, when the dancers were on stage, I laughed. I thought it was a joke. It reminded me of a poor high school dance routine that had the dancers out of time with eachother. Not long after though, perhaps distracted by the costumes, the choreography got better. I really started to enjoy the show. It was great. All the way up until a woman jumped into a giant pool with massive pythons, which were clearly desperate to get out. Then she started dragging them under water and trying to twist them around her body whilst they tried bolting for the edge. This followed by an act with ponies being dragged around the stage (at midnight). Honestly, it’s 2019, I don’t know how animals are still allowed in live stage productions. I really enjoyed it, and I would come back. It’s just unfortunate that I was made uncomfortable by the animal abuse.

We went in June and was advised to get reserved seating. We did but didn't get the one with dinner as we would have had to go over an hour earlier than with the champagne only reserved seats. You can get good seats on the floor but it's first come - first served and we didn't want to get in to the "cattle crunch". We Used Uber to get there about 20 minutes before the show and with reserved seats you didn't have to stand in the long line to get in. The show had some really neat acts between each set. The dancing was top notch and the show and music was fine and enjoyable. The building is dated but it is masked by the darker room. leaving I must say you need to be at the right location for an Uber pickup as they can't stop just anywhere. The correct location is crowded so be patient. We are so glad we went but one time is enough for the experience in our opinion.

We went to Paris with my parents and visited Moulin Rouge on our first full day in the city. We had yet to master the metro system, so I was concerned when we were 10 minutes past the meet up time. What we discovered was that there really wasn’t anyone to “meet”. Tickets were scanned at the door, the ones printed from TripAdvisor. Everything was seamless.
One thing that really stood out to me was regarding the care and concern the people of Moulin Rouge paid to my dad. My dad has a difficult time walking and maintaining his balance on stairs. He is also not one to ask for help. The security at Moulin Rouge and the hostess who was seating us noticed my dad’s difficulty immediately and offered accommodations— allowing us to wait in the lower lobby prior to the start of the show and provided seating on the ground level near the exits.
It was wonderful sitting in the iconic building and seeing what Moulin Rouge has evolved into. The side performances were stellar!
Tip: if you book the late showing on a weekday, make sure to book a cab or Uber as the metro closes at 12:40am. Talking a little walk outside of the congested traffic area is also helpful to your drivers.

This theatre looks old and outdated. Cheap looking, very touristy, no ambiance, no style. Last time we were in this theater (about 20 years ago) the show was amazing, high class performance. Now it is really bad and very disappointing. They didn’t renovate the place since then! The show is very shiny and glittery.but everything, including the songs, the choreography and the dancers felt fake and made from “plastic “. The stage is quite small and the dancers are clustered with no proportion. The dancers didn’t dance in synchronicity with each other and most of them are not very good dancers at all. It was quite ridiculous to see some very tall, not so flexible dancers trying to preform a Can Can dance!
The finale was very pink. To see all the dancers, on this small stage, clustered together, all dressed in bright pink with bright pink feathers, fake pink furs and lots of glitter - felt bizarre.
The guest preformances were good! The original show is horrible.
Not worth the time and the money and can not be compared to Lido. If you are looking to enjoy a stylish, quality show, that’s not the one to choose.

We booked in for the 7pm dinner and show and it was worth every penny. We had a great night, plenty of food and drinks and the show was just amazing. We were lucky and had great seats close to the stage and was easy to see everything. Just an amazing experience.

Honestly I enjoyed the performance from what I could see...the seating is an absolute outrage I was sat pretty much squished up against the stage on the side...I had the best view of the dancers feet all night and almost broke my neck looking up trying to see anything..I was lucky enough to be facing the stage but for the people on the other side of my table with their backs to the stage they basically had to twist their whole body half way around the see anything (their view looking forwards was literally the back wall of the theatre!!!!!!!!!!!)

With performances like this you really need to be facing front on as that is how the aesthetic of the show is planned. The fact they even allow people to sit on the side with their backs to the stage is horrendous. These tickets are NOT cheap! I would say I missed out on half the show due to the bad seating!!!

We thought we are going to see a dancing show, like in New york. We took the dinner+show. When we got there we discovered we are sitting with 4 more people next to a tiny table. The food was not that good. The show was a bog dissapointment to us : very nice clothing but very poor dancing ): it lasted more and more, and was boring. It is simply a big tourist tramp ! And we fell right to it...
Looking a bit tired, looks like a cheap version of Pas Vegas, costume fall apart as you watch, use of live animals, ponies in this type of environment is really unconscionable.

We went one hour before the performance started and the theater was already full and there was band to entertain the guests.
At the beginning I wasn’t happy at all with our sitting, because we were exactly next to the stage. But after watching the show I think that there is no bad sitting to see the show. We felt like we were part of the show. My favorite part was the skating couple.
If we go again I would buy the VIP tickets

My husband and I went for both dinner and show. We didn't have much expectation as we were trying to find some activities (being in Paris itself for 7 nights) for the night. While waiting to go in, the dated decor and somewhat chaotic lining up at the entrance confirmed our belief. But once we stepped in, we were taken by surprise the grandeur lighting and decor, the table arrangement looked as if it came out from movies I seen (when i was younger, 20+ years ago). The wait for the show was long and the food was so so. But we enjoyed the champagne. The show was spectacular, the costumes and dance was beautiful. We were glad we came to watch. When we return for holiday, will not hesitate to bring family members along (kids should be above 18 year of age though). It is expensive, but I will pay for the experience.

We showed up early for our 11:00 pm show. They file you in up a set of stairs, gather you in a huge hall, file you back down the stairs in a more orderly fashion, pass you through another hallway, down another flight of stairs, then in to the main room, which by the way is amazing! This all took maybe 30-45 minutes??? Feels like you went back in time. So much to take in. The tables are really close together, maybe 6 to 8 people at each table down on the floor. I noticed smaller tables on different levels. It all depends where you sit on the type of show you book I guess. They have dinner and drink shows and just drink shows. We did the drink show which came with a bottle of champagne. Soon the lights dimmed and the show began!!! I was in awe. This is something I wanted to do if I ever made it to France. There were topless dancers but it was sophisticated and classy! I would definitely recommend the experience! Bucket list.....check!! 🇫🇷

This show was colorful, campy, crowded, fun and just what I expected. There’s no table service so order a bottle w your tickets. It’s very organized, started on time and the performers were good. We were entertained for 90minutes.
If you use Uber, cross the street when it’s over and catch your ride in front of the Starbucks where there are no crowds.

Start with the positive... The venue is great. Loads of history.

The show, well that's another thing. It was like watching an outtake from a David Copperfield show from the 80s. Overblown and overpriced tosh. Music awful. Most of the male dancers out of time with each other and the music. And having to wear the most god awful costumes!
The women were better but just too many of them. Less is more!

The acts between the dancing were quite good and a welcome break from the big dance numbers.
And the can can was of course great!

Second time at Moulin Rouge. Got it with the dinner, which had three levels of quality, our group had all three and they were equally good. Show was long with amazing costume changes, classic dances mixed with modern dance and circus type acts. A best buy.
We booked "Feerie" and we simply enjoyed! Really great performance! we will visit next time for sure! Loved it!

The Moulin Rouge show was much more than I had expected. I opted for the champagne and show experience rather than the dinner included choice so I can't comment on the food although my table companion seemed satisfied. The show itself is something that I will not forget. Stellar stage sets, fabulous dancers, and quite a few acts that literally took everyone's breath away. At one point, a water tank rose from the floor and a dancer plunged into a tank filled with enormous sea snakes. At first I was wondering if they were actually real, living sea snakes. They were most definitely real. So, yes, I highly recommend the Moulin Rouge. It deserves its reputation as a highlight of Paris.

We took the 11pm show with champagne, the show was colourful, very entertaining and fast moving.
You certainly were not bored. Costumes were amazing.
The theatre was full, but I didnt think was too squashy as I had read in previous reviews. It certainly is warm in there, so wear layers that you can take off. Highly recommend.

I was nervous about booking this experience due to the high price point and I would urge anyone who isn’t sure not to worry and to go out for a good meal instead. Go and look at the outside but you’re honestly not missing out at all by not going.

Other reviews say that the dress code is clear. There was absolutely no reference to the dress code on my ticket and the dress code is referenced only under the FAQs on the website (you can find this at the bottom of the website in teeny tiny letters). My boyfriend was turned away for wearing shorts (they were black smart and to the knee and it was a hot august night) despite the fact that there were multiple women wearing shorts (the door staff informed me this is ok- women having skin on show people seem to like?! What a surprise), men in vests, lots of sports shoes (also a no no per the website). It just seems to be enforced on a case by case basis (discriminatory). When we went next door to a tourist gift shop they offered us jeans for 45 euros from behind the counter- the man instantly knew what we had come for. This was a bad start to the night. I was upset but I was desperate not to miss the show based on what we had paid even though this was just adding to the cost.

The queuing system is a bit of a mess and if you do decide to go I wouldn’t worry about turning up early as there doesn’t appear to any method to the madness- I don’t think it guarantees you a better seat. We had good seats, raised and central which I was so happy about as I think that would have broken me. There were a number of people who were seated right on the side of the stage and for the single price I can see why you’d be disappointed. Inside the little lamps and tables are nice and give a genuine impression that you’ve gone back in time.

The majority of the dancers are really good and the acrobatics numbers in particular are really impressive. However, I would also agree that some dancers were out of time. The number with the snakes in the pool I agree with other reviewers should be removed- I felt uncomfortable watching it. The sets were dated and some of the costumes were similar to cheap panto styles. I know that the site is historical but the whole show needs a refresh/ update.

I live in London and I’ve seen a number of shows so perhaps my experience is coloured by how lucky I’ve been to see some amazing performances- even from the cheap seats. I loved the burlesque element and it was something different.

In conclusion if you’re desperate to go don’t turn up in shorts unless you’re a lady then you can show as much skin as you want (also referencing a reviewer below I’m not American so confusion is not limited- I thought that was a bit rude), and know it’s expensive for what it is and you might get a terrible seat.

A simply magical experience. It’s difficult to describe how truly special an evening at the Moulin Rouge show is. The building is captivating when lit up at night and the internal decor is equally as special.

I booked a ticket for the Féérie show at 9pm. Doors open at 8pm. I would recommend following the advice of dressing up smartly for the evening - they were letting in people in jeans and trainers but it’s a special experience and it’s nice to be wearing something commensurate to the occasion.

As for the show itself I was captivated from the very beginning - the music is a mix of upbeat, big band spectaculars. Seeing a melange of 80 men and women take to the stage in spectacular dresses is a sight to behold. The dancers perform with such energy and the costume changes in between songs must be a hurried affair but it is all carried off impeccably. The dance troupe sections are complemented by some high risk and high jeopardy acts - I hadn’t watched any preview beforehand (there is little to be found online as Moulin Rouge seem very protective over their brand and music which make this all the more special) so was literally gobsmacked when I saw the the stage floor disappear to reveal something I have never seen before in a theatre!

My favourite songs were the catchy chants ‘Paris Danse’ and the signature song ‘Féérie.’ Such was my enthusiasm I purchased the CD soundtrack - if you like the music the ONLY place you can get the music from the show is from the official CD - no Spotify, no Amazon Music - nothing. I haven’t stopped playing it since.

All in all a truly wonderful experience and I cannot wait to come back in the future and see it again.
We really enjoyed the show at the Moline rouge; we liked the dancers, the lights also. If we have free time, I love to have this experience again.

Loved the show-was great to watch & moves at a fast pace - individual specialty performances were amazing. We included the dinner option prior but in hindsight would have skipped (or go with the VIP treatment if you can afford it) - meal & service was perfectly fine, but you sit for 2hrs in quite cramped, noisy environment - might be more fun if with your own group but your sitting with total strangers. Was aware of line-up situation to get inside but think we were seated within about 20mins once they started the seating process
Costumes were pretty impressive. Lively and entertaining performance that my wife and I both loved. Do recommend to arrive a little early to ensure a better seat and getting the champagne package.

We went to the 9pm show on Christmas Day - it tells you to get there for 8.15pm but we decided to go a little earlier because we were worried about seats. Seats are allocated on the night but it definitely helped that we got there earlier than most. People already there were the ones eating dinner - I had read on many reviews that the food was average and to eat somewhere else beforehand - very happy we did this!! We ate at Le Basilic very close by.

We got given good enough seats but there are definitely some which I would not have been happy with. It’s a very tight squeeze and you can see the stress on the waiters who are catering for such a large audience. For us however we didn’t need to interact with the waiters because we got the ticket and champagne experience.

The show was good fun - didn’t like that they had live animals involved personally but overall I would recommend, we had a great time and it was basically a show of top less women.

If you haven’t seen the moulin rouge film do not watch it before. It means you’ll have unrealistic expectations of the live show!

Moulin Rouge has been on my bucket list since I can't remember when and when I finally had the chance to go I jumped on it. We bought our tickets on line from Canada and had absolutely no problem when it came to use them. It takes you back to the glamorous days when people dressed to go out and enjoy the evening. It's burlesque and if you don't understand that before you go you may not enjoy and appreciate it for what it offers, but I can tell you that is was one of the best nights out we had. Well worth the money!!!

For over $300 to just see a show it wasn’t worth it. It was a show with a 70’s theme & the dancers weren’t very good. They cram you at a table with other couples & you can barely see the show. The table beside us was extremely loud & management did nothing about it. Save your money.

one of the highly recommend activities in Paris! They has people waiting outside the ticket box even we were arrived late. also given information for the bus tour. the seats may not be the best but at least able to see the show. show itself is fantastic! great and thanks
I needed to change the date on my ticket well in advance of the show. Neither Ticketmaster or Moulin Rouge would help exchange the ticket for a different day or process a refund.

This is 100% worth doing, once. Don't go expecting "theater"; this is Las Vegas in Paris with less silicone. The costumes, choreography and music are fun and entertaining! We arrived 30 minutes prior to show time with our printed tickets purchased through TripAdvisor/ Viator and were seated in less than 10 minutes at a table with 2 other couples. Our complimentary champagne arrived 5 minutes after being seated.
Fun night. Bit of queuing and you are seated with randoms (a smelly woman was right next to me) but it was a good thing to do on the last night

Was very impressed with our Moulin Rouge experience. The theater is very intimate, the decor charming. It was clean and well-kept. The show was wonderfully entertaining, fantastic costumes and great variety of acts. Our table was right beside the stage so we had an excellent view! The staff were very polite and our champagne was perfectly chilled!!
The only downside was the companies use of live snakes and real miniature ponies, we would have preferred no animals.
Overall, even though the tickets are expensive, we felt it was a one off Parisian experience not to be missed, and being at the theater where Edith Piaf sang was a thrill.

It is a bucket list thing to do in Paris but it oh la la what tosh.
Totally over-rated.
Packed in like sardines on the tiniest of tables sharing with 4 others.
The ticket price is exorbitant but the saving grace is the bottle of champagne included. After a few glasses of bubbly the tackiness of the set, costumes & dance routines wears off a little but rather than watching a very outdated circus show and ending up feeling more sorry for the animals and embarrassed for the guys dancing in silver sequin spandex it would be so much better if it were just a blast of the can-can.

I went with my 24 year old daughter but we were both very disappointed. The dancing and choreography were not in the same league as other shows such as Broadway musicals and it seemed a confusion of themes with intermittent random circus acts. We personally found it unnecessary tacky with the constant display of bare breasts, lacking any romanticism or seductive qualities of historical Parisian culture. Acts including the ponies and pythons are also not acceptable in this day and age.

There was absolutely no need to include the part with the snakes ‘drowning’ in the tank, there was also no need to parade the little ponies. Both events are definitely unnecessarily stressful for the animals and add nothing to the MR experience.

In the year 2019 I would also expect more gender equality. If it is deemed important to have such a heavy focus on topless women (also unnecessary in my view), then please at least apply the same to the men who were for the most part even overdressed.

Dancing ok but not spectacular.

On a positive note: nice costumes and colors

The Moulin Rouge Show reflects what the Moulin Rouge is: a Show that pushed social standards of morality, dress, art, et al during its time. For example, Can Can dancing was outrageous since it had legs being held over the dancer's head while exposing under her dress. Tame by today's standards but we came to see the Real Can Can like we went to see the authentic Rockettes at Radio City Music Hall New York. The Show is lots of fun since it has lots of activity and motion (not to mention loud music) and is a reflection of what made the Moulin Rouge great. Granted there are a lot of Tourists jammed together at small tables with marginal food but that's not why we're here. We came for the Moulin Rouge Spirit & Energy. In that, the Show is GREAT! Artistry be damned - we get that at the Louvre & D'orsay. For a lively energetic and engaging Show it is fantastic. Some of the stuff we thought was strange but the Dutch & English people we were seated with really liked it - which means that it appeals to everyone at some time (even Americans). Frankly, we though the Tickets were too cheap. Try buying show tickets in New York, Las Vegas, Los Angeles, & Chicago - it's twice as much. From that viewpoint the Moulin Rouge Show is a Great Value. Must see if your in Paris ! Well done , really enjoyed the show can’t miss it ! Well worth the money

We took the late show, starting at 2300. The seating was great, the staff very friendly and the show was spectacular. Don't go to paris without visiting the Moulin Rouge.

Fantastic night, went with my daughter, both of us thoroughly enjoyed the show, well worth the money. I got the tickets with the champagne, which actually was great value.

Bucket list thing to do so well worth ticking it off. Couple of extra special acts otherwise I’d have to say expensive for what it was. But when in Paris

This place was always on my bucket list, so a long weekend in Paris & tickets to the Moulin Rouge were booked as a surprise for my birthday. I had visions in my head, so was slightly disappointed to find it crammed within a normal high street (my own fault for referring to the film!). Once inside however, we loved the magic of it, the low lighted lamps on each table, waiter service & the happy ambiance. We requested a table towards the rear as I have a snake phobia & knew that there was an act involving boa constrictors (which was only a few minutes long and from where I was, was easily avoided!). The table was perfectly situated and the waiters attentive from the moment we arrived. There are a few mixed reviews on here about the food, but the four of us found it very nice. Warm, tasty and very smartly presented. We had two bottles of champagne included in our package which went down very well! ... The show itself ... not as 'professional' as you would assume. The costumes were amazing and the overall visual was superb, but the dancers were not to the standard we expected (timings were out, some dancers were lack-lustre & the synchronicity was just not there), but it didn't spoil our enjoyment. It was full on, eclectic craziness & by the end we were all a bit dazed about what we had seen ... but in a good way! It was definitely worth the visit, it is a happy tick off my bucket list ...

It was still good but missed the mark a little. The high light was the roller skaters. They were incredible. Would I recommend this show? Absolutely. My husband and I both loved it.

I thought it was a good show. No regrets. An entertaining evening. Those sitting at the tables that were long wise facing the stage had a bit more of a chore to be able to turn and see the show. We were very welcomed. Nice music, nice bodies, nice place! It´s not cheap, but worth it! The only thing I didn´t like was the photo taken before the show, because the photographer says it´s 21 euros for 1 big and 2 small photos. When we receive them , it was 1 big indeed, but the other 2 were matches cover...

The show is amazing, it last around 1 hour and 30 minutes. Non stop show, with modern customs, but very well design, and choreography. Have a bottle of champagne for 2, and enjoy one of the most popular shows in Paris. Well worth it. Get ahead of time, as the security screening and the line gets long.
Even Paris is expensive..this iconic place is worth it. Movie like settings and atmosphere. Great spot for a romantic weekend in Paris.

Fun! Topless dancers and fully clothed men but still entertaining!! The show would be better with a little balance showing scantily clothes sexy men. The unusual smaller shows within this production such as the double jointed woman were so entertaining and unexpected.

If you're wondering whether or not you should go, the show is really quite impressive and is like a mix of showgirls with cirque du soleil. The price is high but the Moulin Rouge is world renown so you're paying for the hype in addition to the show. It is very entertaining and, in my opinion, worth the price but I would advise against taking children or teenagers. It is very revealing and I would advise for the parents who thought otherwise to have their heads examined.

I was very much looking forward to seeing the show. The Theatre itself is lovely. But you do feel like you're squeezed in, and for some, viewing was restricted.
The performance was ok! But like most reviews, I preferred the acrobat parts.

We were quickly ushered to our table, and given our champagne (in wine glasses) but not made aware where we could purchase more drinks (or even ask for water) the staff seemed stressed, and constantly running around.

I also don't understand why in 2019 you need animals on stage (even if it's for a short amount of time)

My partner described the show as a mixture of a Disney show and The ladyboys of Bangkok!!

Will definitely be going to The Crazy Horse if I visit paris again..

Was very compact inside ...
Very dissapointed clearly states on my voucher man to wear a tie...bought one for my teenage son as well
Half the men did not have a tie...
Double standard...
Service was poor...
Show ok..there was only three shows we enjoyed...women and men shows are overrated..
Nothing spectacular..
First and last...
Great show. The best performance of the CanCan we have seen. Be warned, there is a bit of topless dancing during the show. Highly energetic show.
The MOULIN ROUGE SHOW was the best the best show I've ever seen in my life it's like I felt so young

Our first time at Moulin Rouge. So glad we went! It was like a Vegas show! So many different acts and performances! Perfect for a date night if you want to have that classic Paris experience. Not tacky at all, we loved it!

An amazing show! It met all my expectations. All dancers are amazing and they do work hard to produce one of the best show I ever saw in the world. All show girls got great bodies and they are perfect dancers and athletes, some parts of the show need a physical strength, grace and elegance. The only thing I was not happy about, it’s a bit of waiting to be seated. But as soon as the show started, I forgot about all the world. I will be back to Mosulin Rouge as soon as I will be back to Paris!

A fantastic night of entrainment, a varied range of acts.
Staff very helpful and accommodating.
Good value for money.
Don’t miss out. Go to this show, splurge and get the dinner as well. Great dancing, costumes and technical work. When in France it’s a must!
Fantastic! Costumes are amazing. Beautiful theatre. Staff very nice and helpful. Fir my friends birthday Janet, she will never forget this show.

Fantastic show well worth waiting on. Costumes spectacular as were the various different acts.
The acrobatics were great. Fun and had the audience on they're feet
This show was amazing! The theatre was so cool! The only negative was they pack you in like sardines with no air conditioning to wait prior to the show. Once inside the experience is unbelievable.

I would highly recommend. After reading some negative reviews I was very concerned but i decide to go. I never regret! It was amazing and great experience. The line was. Was very decent and fast. Staff was amazing and helpful. Great and professional. Great show. Highly recommend!

The show was amazing! The show was burlesque, and the dancers were scantily dressed at times (which was expected) but the acrobatics were exceptional and we would love to see it again if we are back in Paris! We have and will highly recommend it to our friends!!

If you want to get the best table you need to dress up. May be inconvenient to pack a suit or a dress, but it got us 4” from the stage. Dinner was good and the show was great. Use Uber to get there and back.
Great show. Food was nice. A must see experience in France. Having the meal gets you the best seats. The VIP experience gets you the front row, but you miss out on the complete stage view.

Staff were very snob and would ignore you they brought the drink very quickly but the rest God help you to get their attention!!!! we had to ask 4 Times to get glass of water they wouldn't come back to check if guest need anything either, Food was very ordinary and you think when you pay close to 600$ for two at list you get better food.
we got there very early to make sure we get a good seat from the reviews that others have left thought it would be good move, however we were the 10th and the 11th person in line...seating took place and we were place in not a very good site although very close to stage but table was not well placed to see the stage well.
after food was served and took 2 hours right at the time show was going to start they brought a couple and placed them right Infront of us that blocked our view completely and we had to keep on moviing to be able to see, !!! so if I paid this much and had dinner and show they go on and bring someone who just paid for show and place them in front of us!!!! why did we pay the extra when all we see is back of someone's head?
Show was nice for the part of course we could see from where we were. But would I pay this much to go back? absolutely not

This was such an incredible show. I was entertained the entire time. They have so many performers on stage at a time that every seat in the house gets has a great view. The acrobats were also breathtaking

The show was spectacular from beginning to end . Costumes are beautiful, dancers are talented and elegant . The sets were colorful and ever changing.
A evening to remember!
Well when I’m Paris you have to do it really. Good spectacle and worth the show albeit a little pricey. Costumes are great and the acrobatic interval acts are fantastic. Great experience 😊

Do not miss if you visit Paris! Such a fun show! We went with our 17 year old son and he liked it as much as my husband and I. Either eat at the show or eat before in a different neighborhood as we did not find the choices very good by the venue!

The worst customer service experience of my life. Absolutely impossible French style bureaucracy in ever attempting to get a refund. It took 18 months, dozens of emails and a very inconvenient method for repayment. Just watch the movie ! Not worth visiting.
We were here with colleagues and it was even more spectaculair as we expected. Lights actors dancers stages everything was just so excited.

Amazing show. Brilliant acts.
Worth a visit!
Ques are really really long and people are huddled together really closely in the foyer beforehand

My husband and I attended the Moulin Rouge show and included the bottle of champagne to enjoy during! I highly recommend seeing this famous show during your visit as there is nothing like it (that I know of). The seating is quite tight but we were okay, nothing you can do about it- just something to keep in mind.
Incredible show! 100% recommend! It was absolutely amazing! So fun to watch! The colors, the music and everything was overall entertaining! We went home singing that night! Can’t wait to go back!
Fantastic and I met some awesome people. The horses, snakes, elaborate costumes, and the stunts preformed were awesome.
Girls were beautiful and danced very well but the guys looked cheesy and not in sync with the girls. But the cool performers were awesome!!
Spectacular show. Food good but not great. Good, friendly staff. Professionally run, we had a great night
All of the show was great. Liked the rollerskaters, contortionist the most. Champagne was good. Captivating show. View was not the best but adjustments made.
First time at MR. Great atmosphere and really good show. Outfits were spectacular. Would definitely go again!
Great show! Everything from dancing to roller skates and a slithering surprise! Nudity is tastefully done, my wife and I enjoyed.
If your looking for something different but still authentically french whilst visiting the amazing city- this is no.1

It was a full acrobatics and dance show, which in my opinion would have been just as good without some of the nudity parts. It Is something you must try, if you have it on your wish list, but not something I would go to twice.

The show itself was spectacular! We also met a nice couple at our table and we ended up going out with them afterwards to top off the night.
The service people at the show were also nice and helpful, no waiting in line or anything, just right to our table with a bottle of Champagne!
I knew this would be entertaining but had no idea this show would be one of the highlights of the trip. I would highly recommend anyone who travels to Paris takes in this show. Amazing!
Was a very take breathing amazing and unforgettable show. The best, the number 1. I highly recommend it.
Surpassed my expectations. Don’t know how we managed to get a table next to the stage but wonderful experience. Been on my bucket list and didn’t fail to impress
Gutted. Unable to attend due to sickness. It really would have been nice to have had some sort of refund or chance of another date, especially as I was trying a few days before the show.
Amazing show with seats so close to the stage!! Bottle of bubbly was great - We loved it!! Definitely recommend!

Visited Paris for a business trip and spent an evening with my close associates for an evening show (11pm) at Moulin Rouge. Agreed that it is not really child friendly but perhaps that it is an Asian perspective. Fun evening for the adults. Seating arrangement does depend on certain luck as we are guided by the show usher for seatings at a table. And luckily we did get a good spot even though we opted for the show package without champagne for a lower entrance ticket. There were five of us so we didn't had to share any table with anyone else.

I attended the 9pm viewing, so the one without dinner. It's very crowded at the tables with people all squeezing in I couldn't imagine the dinner being that enjoyable. But the show is great and definitely a must if you're in Paris and haven't been before.
This was for my wife whose birthday is the 23rd of December so never gets to do anytging special, i was told it was be best present shes ever had including Paris... I think that says it all really
Thd show is fantastic & staff wonderful, but beware of Adults bring 5yr old little girl & non stop talking a table but 1..

Fab dancing great show good bubble just a little disappointed with only only one can can dance dance also the late Sunni g of the show before so missed the metro back had to get s taxi
Margaret

It was a very enjoyable evening, It was my husband's birthday and he loved it. The only thing we didnt like was the sitting, we were expecting a table for the two of us but in there you are sit with other people sharing a table and we happen to be sit we a very grumpy woman. we felt sorry for the man though.

The show is good the remarkable thing about it is that they had a Can can traditional dance. I had seen Lido and Crazy Horse and they are the only ones that had this Can Can show.
If you want to have dinner is pretty expensive. I recommend that you arrived in advance, you can go by metro because they leave you at the front door then take a cab if you go to the 11 pm show cause Metro is close. Make sure you asked the driver how much.
The dancers are beautiful and scenery too.
Loved this place! Although it has mixed reviews i liked it thoroughly. Great vibes in here. A wonderful and iconic photo prop!

The famous place where Satine's and Christian's love story began and ended. If The Moulin Rouge is your favourite movie or just enjoy amazing dancing and extravegant costumes this is the place for you. It;s quite impressive on the outside too to be honest and there is just so much more inside. The choreography and execution is so on point and a good time is guaranteed! However, it is very very expensive, you need to save up if you want to go there regardless of the season. There is a gift shop just up the road which has all sorts of little knick-knacks and memorabilia that you can purchase. My partner and I went there and we absolutely loved it. I reccommend but don't feel bad if you can't afford it because just looking at it (and me being an absolute fan of the movies, it's my favourite) was impressive and enough for me.

We had heard all the stories about the glitz, history and glamour of the Moulin Rouge, so we decided to make it the finale of our Paris trip. Wow- really wish we had skipped it! The word “cheesy” perfectly sums up the show. My husband and I felt like we were trapped on a cruise ship circa 1978. The dancers were overly made-up, overacting, and lip-synching. Definitely not worth it.
We went with a group of 3 couples, very organized and on time. It’s a lifetime experience that one should have. Don’t expect extraordinary performance, overall it was nice and we enjoyed it.
Everyone was on sync, the drinks were good, we had great seats! This was definitely an experience to remember. Very sexy (but not trashy), my date and I really enjoyed this iconic show!
Hesitant at first since we only had 2 days in Paris. Turned out to be the best show of our lives! You cannot miss this if you’re in Paris!
It was the best show I have ever witnessed!!! Unforgettable experience a must See if you ever visit Paris. It went beyond and above all expectations.

We loved it! Went to see late 11pm show, few glasses of champagne before and during a show was great! Helped us to enjoy the show even more :) Got seated with 4 strangers, but 10 minutes into we were all best friends! I think ones in a lifetime you have to go and see Moulin Rouge show! Great dancers, great colorful costumes!
A very good show a very good night out costume were amazing show was awesome we would highly recommend
What a great time. Really a great show and a great overall experience. If you want to see a French Cabaret this is the show.

This is our second time to see this show. We were here with friends two years ago and went to the late show and had a blast. This time we were back with our son and daughter-in-law and 12 year old granddaughter and we all loved the show and the Paris experience.

This was my second time to the show and my husbands first time and we both thought the show was spectacular! The show is beautifully choreographed, the costumes are beautiful and the music was wonderful! A must when visiting Paris!
Enjoyed the show, well worth its price. Show was well choreographed and entertaining. Awesome dancers and great talent. Full of dances, songs and acrobatic talents.

The show was as advertised and reviewed ahead of time. The seating was tight, we opted not to eat at the show, I am glad. Bar right across the street was awesome, good food, fair pricing, and lots of room. The show was nothing special, my wife and I commented that is was a little more upscale than an all inclusive show you would get at one one of the big Apple vacation spots. I would say that I am glad I went, when in Paris I guess.
The show was remarkable. The costumes and the colors were very pretty. We were served champagne as we watched. It was very entertaining.
It was nice but for the price that you have to pay, it was a bit overrated, and honestly a bit outdated

Thoroughly enjoyed my evening show, with Champagne.
The seats are a little squashed unless you have an outside one, but it is an authentic blast from a bye-gone era and you quickly become immersed in the show.
The dress, art, talent and displays were wonderful and had me captivated from start to finish.This was one of my main highlights of the trip to Paris and would highly recommend it - especially with the Champagne, which was the icing on the cake.

We visited the Moulin Rogue on a late saturday evening. The seating is very tight but we had a great view. The include champagne was great and the whole show was an amazing spectacle and worth the money paid. The ladies and men put on a great show with lots of surprises I will not forget je suis adore

My husband and I did the Toulouse menu with the show for our honeymoon. It was a very unique experience. The food was good and staff was professional. The show was spectacular- the performers are all very talented. The only negative is that once everyone is seated (including those who were not there for the dinner portion), it is cramped. Also you are not allowed to take pictures inside so expect to have a professional photographer take your picture for 30 plus euros.

There were far too many people packed in the auditorium and we were sat on a table with a group of people who didn't speak to us. The dancing was great and the outfits were fabulous but I don't think the ponies were happy to be performing on stage and the snakes seemed desperate to escape the water tank. A memorable experience overall.

It was coordinated well. I was dissapointed overall. Just a lot of boobs & shaking. Except for one pole dancer & 2 skatters, i wouldn’t recommend this show.
Food was sub par too.
Commercialized.
We were asked to show up at 6:

While I am glad I went to see this show, it would have been much more enjoyable if it wasn't sooooo packed and crowded!! The wait staff was overwhelmed and not very pleasant. The food was ok, but the service was slow. The show was fabulous!!! I enjoyed it even thought it was hard to see through the people crowded next to us. I'm glad I went, but I don't think I'd go again.
First time in 25 years. Room seems bigger? Acts and costumes are wonderful. They do more than one show a night and sometimes they did seem jaded. But still definitely worth a visit.

The colorful shows,the skill of dancing, beautiful men and women, the stages, the sound system everything made you feel you are in the year 1800. I have read so many things about Moulin Rouge that I literally could connect with it.

If you’ve been to a Vegas show, it’s a lot like that. The performers are top notch and it’s very entertaining. My least favorite parts were the animal segments. They really add very little to the show and I’m not sure why they continue to include them in this day and age.

What a great show, absolutely Amazing. It would have to be a must see for anyone traveling to Paris, great atmosphere from when you arrive to when you leave and the staff were so helpful, polite and friendly at all times. You won't be Disappointed

We decided last minute to book Moulin Rouge. Due to the popularity of the show we were only able to purchase the late night show with half glass of Champagne. When entering into the auditorium we were ushered to front row seats - we could literally touch the performers! We were poured our first full glass of champagne and shared another two bottles with a couple sitting beside us. The Champaign was excellent. We have been to many Cabarete type shows and I would recommend this one while in Paris. It was classy and entertaining with more than just beautiful, athletic woman dancing in costumes. We enjoyed a few drinks at a local brewery and cafe prior to the show - a vibrant and unique area of Paris.

We came to see this show it was amazing, we had brilliant seats we ordered champagne and they bring it to your table, we came here with my mum and they catered for her disability needs with no struggle, there were people of all ages, a spectacular show with amazing costumes how those girls wear the head gear i'll never no, most of the girls are topless but not all, there is also a gift shop here for souvenirs to remember the evening

If you have any preconceptions about The Moulin Rouge then they are probably all true! A spectacle of fabulous dancing, costumes and acrobatics. It was a little crowded on our table and we had to ask twice for the champagne that came with the ticket but overall it is all managed very effectively.
We did notice that despite the dress code quite a few people were in jeans and trainers and the family on the table next to us even brought out sandwiches! (Not a bad idea maybe!!)

What a MAGNIFICENT and entertaining 11:00 pm show at Moulin Rouge! We were surprised at the variety of acts, including the necessary “can-can” dance! We had a wonderful and colourful view from our seats! The roller skating act and snake swim had us gasping with awe! Add a bottle of champagne and our evening show was complete!
Excellent. Fully recommend for a great show in Paris. The dancers are amazing. Worth every dollar. You are not allowed to take photos once the show starts.
Great show, took the kids... food was pretty good too... in the end it is a little long.... but a highly enjoyable experience!

My only complaint is it went to quickly! We splashed out for the belle epoche menu and with the setting and show over champagne it was truly a feast for all the senses. A night I will never forget and highly recommend. 10 stars out of 5!!!
A must when in Paris! The theatre, the dancers, the intermittent acts and most importantly the costumes where amazing! This show does not disappoint!

We were sat right at the front next to the stage, with other English couples who we soon got talking to which added to the evening. Food and drink was served promptly and was good, we adjusted our table positions a little bit so those of us not facing the stage could turn around easily.
The show overall was superb. There is a lot of flesh on display but nothing distasteful and as the show progresses you hardly notice. There are a number of acts to keep you enthralled for the complete show. Will go again one day.
We visited there 10:30 pm and lining and waiting for one hour to come in the theater. Then, it was finished by 1:00 am.
This show has to be on your bucket list. It’s truly entertaining and keeps you engaged to the end. Service is also top notch.

It's very beautiful cabaret hall in Paris. The show was excellent.

We decided to treat our friends to a show and we were not disappointed. An excellent performance, with many parts of the show that take your breath away.
Classic and brilliant performance.

Food and champagne were good but not outstanding. Remember you are in Paris the home of Michelin star restaurant like Le Pré Catelan.

We visited the show at 9 a.m.The program was great!! Amazing. Great show!
We bought our tickets 2 hours before the show and the place were still great.
A great show. Colourful costumes and dance group of high standards. The food was nothing to be exited about, although the desert was very tasteful.

Awesome show!! A must see when in Paris! We didn’t have dinner there, but went to 9 pm show with champagne. Don’t listen to the hype that it’s overrated, or a tourist trap- it was amazing and so fun!!
One of the best shows we have seen. it is very fast-paced with lots of different acts one right after another.
Amazing show. It’s expensive but so worth it. If you do anything in Paris, see this show! It’s quite explicit but it’s the Moulin Rouge- plus you get champagne!

The show was just as I had expected and more. There was dancing and stunt type acts. My friends and I went to the 11pm show. The ticket was $122/person which covered a table and 1 1/2 bottles of champagne (3 people).

Moulin Rouge was not what I expected yet it was fantastic; even if overpriced. The dancing was amazing, the show just about the right length. I didn't see the need for so much exposure of boobs; I get it was part of the original theme but honestly the dancers were better a little covered, and the men need to be part of the show a bit more. Champagne was good. Only one negative was those that needed to visit the bathroom in mid show was very distracting as everyone was sat so close!

Lifetime dream achieved!
Booked the 9pm session, with half bottle of champagne. Was told to arrive early to queue up. Got there at 8.15pm and shown straight to our table. Perfect! Absolutely amazing shown, so colourful & loud! Loved it. Everything I dreamed of.

The show is amazing and quiet a few unexpected performances...worth every penny! I do recommend that you just get tickets for the show, the food is not the greatest...there are so many wonderful restaurants 5 to 10 minutes walking distance. What a great night...the costumes, the variety of acts...just wonderful!

We were very professionally received. Although the queue was long we entered the in time. Be sure to get there early to get a good table. Show was top class and met all our expectations. A once in a lifetime experience not to be missed

Great show, we went there for a birthday .
The dancers were just amazing, very entertaining.
The price is obviously slightly dear but once in a life it's worthy
Fantastic experience. Half a bottle of champagne each and the best show in a long time. The costumes and atmosphere were amazing Highly recommended
A was a very nice experience, with high tempo all the time, but actually the shows in between the cabaret was the most exciting parts.
The show was cancelled but trip adviser reimbursed our fee. We were looking forward to this show very unfortunate it was cancelled last minute
Fun night, be prepared to sit with others you may not know & enjoy the glamour, the feather, the beads & dancing
I was dragged here by my wife yawning and moaning and left a true believer. The shows were amazing almost magical and I could feel the history in the place.

We wanted the genuine Parisian experience and although so many great looking and talented dancers, the choreography and musical choices were not very innovated and corny-very Las Vegas meets 1980’s. The best number and the iconic one is the can can -wish it was longer and last though.
Very pricey and rude waiters - huge theatre -choose earlier show. Call Uber as cabs are expensive at night.

The number of costumes and choreography are amazing. I didn’t count but it could have been 30 + costume changes for a group of up to 40 people. It is the place to have champagne and see the famous Can Can... it’s a step into history with the excitement of a Broadway Production in Las Vegas. Let’s not forget the amazing gal and guy on a 6’ diameter roller rink with heart stopping acrobatics on roller skates.

The show was really very interesting. Costumes and music were amazing. Off course there was no specious seats but that was ok. And finally avoid the pickpocket after the show. This area is famous for it.
The show was entertaining and my friend and I were pleased that we experienced this we known Paris show.

We pre booked tickets as were quickly selling out. its pricey but it was a special occasion. We went for the 11pm show with half bottle champagne (very nice). The place is a bit tatty and they squeeze you in very tightly (approx. 1,000 people go per showing). The show was great and all 6 of us thoroughly enjoyed it. The pub next door is also great.

The show and dinner were one of our highlights while in Paris. I was gorgeous and very tasteful. Beautiful costumes, delightful dancers, Lovely venue. The dinner was very nice. Would love to go to Paris again to see the show again.
This was a couples trip. Outstanding trip, and experience! The show was fantastic, and the service too, the dinner was only average. I was expecting better food, but Cest Le Vie
The show was more than I had expected. All the costumes were so elaborate and beautiful. I’m so pleased we went. The show was absolutely amazing.
Excellent entertainment and mesmerizing in presentation! The meal selection was very good and the ‘tuna appetizer’ was ‘off the hook!’

Fantastic experience. My husband, adult son and I loved the food and the entertainment. Seating is a bit squeeze in places.
The dancers, and backdrops were beautiful, and some of the acts were thrilling.

My wife always wanted to go to the Moulin Rouge in Paris I thought it was to expensive and wasn't that fused, I was totally wrong it was exceptional and worth every single penny outstanding food, champagne and show is out of this world, in fact I'd love to do it again.
Can't recommend it enough.

About as good as you could hope for.

The show is of course a bit cheesy, and rather predictable (apart from the obvious topless dancers...the usual acrobats, circus-type acts, etc. But then, what else COULD they do. And you know before you come that it's a "variety" sort of show.

But the talent is first rate, the dinner was surprisingly excellent...not Michelin-quality, but very, very nice indeed. Service was as helpful as you could hope for.

Considering that they have a never-ending stream of tourist-related business, I was very impressed that they still bend over backwards to make the experience as fun and rewarding as they possibly can. They could get away with a lot less.

Well done to the Moulin Rouge
All very camp and twee but an okay experience! Thought we were getting half bottle of Champagne but got a whole one, so that was good! Had to be done and glad we did.
The show was great, but the line-ups to get there were very long and three times we had to stand in another line again. Must be some other way to organize people to the show.
Just fabulous. Love it. The girls were beautiful, the set was amazing and the acrobats really leave us speechless.

Don’t miss the opportunity to see this! It’s worth every penny. The athletic abilities of the performers was incredible. The costumes were beautiful. Without giving away the surprise, the water act was unbelievable.

Avoid! Unless you want to pay 450Eur for tickets, get shoved on a shelf unable to see the stage from behind a chandelier with no service. We had a good view of the crowd and someone’s head from our seats - very disappointing.
The show is cativating! I thought that since it has been running forever it may looking a bit tired but that was not the cade. Great evening and the food was good not gourmet but good!
The show was spectacular, the talent is premium, and the costumes breathtaking. The ambiance is enchanting, the Champagne delicious, and not a bad seat in the house. We would love to see it again.
Entertaining! Fun! Great atmosphere! Crowded though. We were closely seated at the same table with 2 other couples. Wish there would have been more space…
Amazing show! Definitely worth a visit to Paris to see Moulin Rouge can’t believe I’ve waited so long to do this. A romantic atmosphere in a stunning venue.
The show absolutely exceeded our expectation’s the performers are amazing and really love what they do . This is a must do for anyone visiting Paris.
Very entertaining performances. The group numbers were fun, but the duos were quite literally mind-blowing. So much talent.
The show was the best I have seen. The wait to get in was very long almost 1 1/2 hours. We had great seats and the energy was awesome. Will definitely recommend this as a must see in Paris .
This show was excellent food was lovely…would highly recommend…just found it hard to get a taxi after the show..otherwise fantastic

I was a little skeptical because I originally wanted the show and dinner option. I took too long in planning, so by the time i was ready to buy that option was sold out. My advice, don't hesitate! Moulin Rouge is part of the Paris vibe, so we did not want to miss it. There was alot of traffic, so we got there 15 minutes before the show. The best thing about this ticket is that the voucher you get is your ticket. No redemption needed, you just get on the line. We got the champagne and show option, and were prepared to sit behind a column, but we got a wonderful table along the right wall and the view was spectacular. No complaints from Tripadvisor at all. We got what we paid for. Inside there was a rude lady that barely let us take a nice picture before the show, which was totally allowed, and it was 10 mins to the show. We were en route to getting seated. Everything else was amazing. Several routines by the dancers, and in between there were acts that showed feats of strength, snake routine. My fave was the roller skate couple and the can can. But overall we loved it. Great champagne, great place. Some nudity, but not raunchy. You can walk the strip afterwards, and find eateries. If I could give more stars, I would!
Absolutely fabulous! From start to finish everything was wonderful. The staff is attentive, it’s extremely well organized- so glad we spent the $ (it isnt cheap!)

The famous Moulin Rouge is so much more than can can girls the show was professionals at their peak performance, amazing acts dances fantastic,entrance and seating was great and a souvenir bag of goodies I think we had the best seats in the house a truly amazing show
Highlight of my trip with a several course meal that was absolutely delicious. The show was colorful, vibrant, and memorable. Absolutely loved it!
Herded like cattle and still not seated at 11:10 for 11pm show. How can they get this right after all these years. 11:15 and in another line.

I enjoyed most of the show except the snakes, don't think we need to use live reptiles anymore
inside the moulin rouge is beautiful.
Felt like being at an adults circus. Costumes were beautiful though and some of the dancing was good, the venue was fun but shows elsewhere are significantly better. Guess it just wasn’t my thing.

We loved the show , it was very glam the girls were beautiful in there costumes and yes they do show a lot of skin , Really nice surroundings But remember you are in a red light area where there is lots of sex shops and lap dance shows , A bit of fun to see
Both me and my wife thoroughly enjoyed the whole experience, you can’t really go to Paris and not see this spectacular show. It was absolutely brilliant from start to finish.

It is definitely not what I expected but I loved the show! Lots of different performances with different themes (not all strictly Parisian), but it was wonderful. Some very talented dancers, singers, and acrobats were a part of this show, leaving the audience in awe! Don’t go in with expectations that this will be completely a stereotypical cancan performance, because it is not!! But that doesn’t detract from the performance
Great show good seats everywhere but show up early to get better seats. Beautiful venue and great show definitely recommend seeing at least once if you visit Paris.

This was our second Moulin Rouge experience and it is still a “must see” in Paris. We had the nice dinner with show 5 years ago and opted for just show and champagne last night. If we go for a 3rd time, we will do dinner and show again. We had very good seats in front of the stage although the seating was very tight like,“jammed in”, but we made it work! The acrobatic acts were amazing as well as the dancers and costumes. We did miss the “live dog talking act” by a ventriloquist from our previous visit which was hilarious. The consensus from our group of 4 was a recommendation to eliminate the girl in water tank with snakes…ugh. Otherwise, highly recommend the Moulin Rouge!!!
Great show! Definitely ranks up there with any show in Las Vegas! Highly recommend! Girls and costumes are very beautiful!
Show and performances were very good! Crowd control for entering is terrible. Waited in line for an hour. Management was not evident.
A very memorable experience! We only did the show with champagne and was fantastic! Very talented performers and a night to remember in Paris!
VIP package was well worth the expense. Private entrance with welcome drink. Amazing show with full view of the stage
Great show the dancers were amazing, costumes were great. Servers were great. Did have a bit of a wait to get into see show.
It was a nice experience. If you are touring Paris, well, watching a show in Moulin Rouge would be a nice part of the agenda.

The auxiliary acts were fantastic. The men that did the balancing act were amazing, it was seriously of Cirque de Sole quality. The roller-skating act was also phenomenal and breathtaking. Costuming was beautiful.

Would have love to go to this but had a medical family emergency and had to cancel our entire trip. There were no options to book this for another date, which we would have been glad to do weeks in advance online. I reached out to Trip Advisor and Viator and got no response. I would book something else that was refundable, just in case.

This was a fantastic show and a wonderful evening overall! We were very entertained and enjoyed the meal also. The singing, the dancing, the special acts were very well done! All 3 generations attending had a great time!
What an absolutely fabulous evening. The quality of the performance was second to none. So well worth the money.
This was really a fun evening. The show was amazing and surprising. Lots of different acts (swimming with snakes, roller skating, etc).

I did Average not because of the 'tour" but the show was not very great. Not our thing, but glad we saw it and can say we did. There were some acts that were good, but for the money tough to say it was worth it. The staff was great, but the show as mediocre.

It's a pretty fun evening, the costumes are expensive looking. The big performance numbers could be better. The acts in between were impressive. There shouldn't be room for animal cruelty in this day and age though. Scrap the snakes in water.

We were mostly there because it's the Moulin Rouge and that's novel in itself. The cabaret isn't world class but it's fun and entertaining.

We had the champagne package and if we hadn't it looked like drinks may be very difficult to come by for the evening.
The whole show was fabulous, the dancers and performers were amazing, well done to all. Well worth the price.
Absolutely awesome show! We had no idea that Moulin Rouge would be a highlight of our time in Paris. Highly recommend!
Fabulous costumes with talented dancers and performers. Music could use a makeover and very crowded in the audience. A good experience.

The show was great. We did not do dinner. The only issue was the seating. Very tight seating. We met a nice couple at our table but everyone was seated shoulder to shoulder and it just wasn’t a comfortable setting to enjoy the show.

Absolutely stunning show. Each and every performance was mesmerizing, not to mention the colorful clothes which would have been meticuliously designed, to the settings to the smiling faces of each and every performer. The entire ambience was worth the experience.The staff from the time we entered were warm and welcoming.Keep it up guys and Goodluck.

Fun show with a variety of performances. It’s a Vegas style show mixed with a few Cirque du Soleil acts.
If you want to avoid crowds, this is not for you.
The show was amazing and flawless. The atmosphere was so good, attentive waiters and the champagne was🤩
The food was just ok - The show was great. Highly recommend the show -I would forget the dinner and try the late show.

We weren’t quite sure what to expect but we loved it! A mixture of everything you could love in a show, something for everyone’s tastes (with both french and English scenes)! We arrived late but the staff we very helpful in getting us in and we were given a full bottle of champagne! The show was brilliant one of the highlights of the trip and a lovely intimate venue!
The dinner was inventive and delicious. Our seats were great. The staff took care of our needs, older and difficult to walk up stairs. They put us to the front of the line.
Do not miss the Moulin Rouge! Dinner was amazing and the show was spectacular! Tickets were printed out, Moulin Rouge was easy to find and no issues at all.
An amazing expierance. Had dinner and show. It was visually breathtaking and spectacular. Highly reccomend
